decision.explanation: Both 'Odakyu Electric Railway' and 'JR East' are cited in separate source documents (D1S1 and D3S1 respectively) as the private railway operators of the 20000 series. These are distinct claims referring to the same subject and are preserved as valid referents per the instruction to retain complementary answers unless contradicted by clear evidence. No definitive resolution is made between them due to lack of disambiguating evidence in the provided sources.
